# New Jersey, Event Staffing Compliance

- **Minimum wage (2026):** $15.92/hour
- **Weekly overtime:** after 40 hours
- **Daily overtime:** none

No daily overtime rule, standard weekly overtime after 40 hours.

_No state-specific quirks tracked beyond the standard rules above._

## Classification

TempGuru classifies **all** workers in New Jersey as W-2 employees regardless of
